_comment: Module-1 parameters for the identity deployment (Part 2 §3.8, §7). scripts/identity_deploy.py reads this file. Every path in `placeholders` must get its real value before a deployment; the plan command refuses placeholders unless --allow-placeholders is given.

identity._comment: Deployment steps 1-3 of Part 2 §3.8: config_holder hash, config_seal policy ID, identity script hash (= policy ID).

module1._comment: New Foundation operator key hash (Part 2 §7, operator keys; old module keys are not reused) and the native-script policy of the CrossValidatorRefs token, locked to that key.

verdict_policy._comment: PLACEHOLDER: the verdict policy is an open item (Part 2 §13.4, owners David and the module owners). The agent of a verdict is the losing side: auditor_wins names the claimer, claimer_wins names the auditor. action: suspend (duration_ms 1..2592000000) or revoke (duration_ms 0). null means no verdict.

protocol_params._comment: v14 mainnet values from deploy/DEPLOY.md. selection_delay, min_agent_age, max_concurrent_cases and min_jury_pool_total are not recorded for v14; these are the params.ak defaults, with min_jury_pool_total = 15 jurors x 25 AP3X. Confirm with the module owners.
